ngaap.guidance: 2021 guidance revised 3-Aug-2021 (guidance as revised | previous guidance April 2021): Revenue $18.1 billion - $18.5 billion | $18.5 billion - $18.9 billion (revised revenue guidance includes the effect of completed divestitures). Organic revenue growth up 3.0% - 5.0% | up 3.0% - 5.0%. Adjusted EBIT margin ~18.5% | 18.0% - 18.5%. Non-GAAP EPS $12.80 - $13.00 | $12.70 - $13.00. Adjusted free cash flow $2.8 billion - $2.9 billion | $2.8 billion - $2.9 billion (as revised, excludes cash income taxes paid or avoided related to taxable gains and losses from sales of businesses). Share repurchases ~$3.4 billion | ~$2.3 billion (as revised, includes the use of net proceeds from completed divestitures).
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP EPS = income from continuing operations per diluted share attributable to common shareholders, excluding L3Harris Merger integration costs, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (all acquired intangibles), business divestiture-related gains/losses and other divestiture-related expenses, impairment of goodwill and other assets / investment and asset impairment charges, restructuring and other items, net of the noncontrolling-interest portion and of income taxes. Adjusted EBIT = net income + discontinued operations + net interest expense + income taxes + the same pre-tax items (it INCLUDES non-operating income / non-service FAS pension income). Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow - net additions of PP&E + cash used for L3Harris Merger integration costs. The income-tax line of the EPS bridge is positive this quarter (+0.17): tax on the divestiture gains exceeds the tax benefit of the other items. 'Investment and asset impairment charges' 180: 145 is the income-statement 'Impairment of goodwill and other assets' line (operating); the remaining 35 (computed difference) is not in operating income (an investment impairment within non-operating income, which is 86 against a pension adjustment of 114) - the item is tagged 'op' as a whole. FCF bridge values are the QUARTER column (two quarters: operating cash flow 1,381, capex (124), FCF 1,257, integration cash 58, adjusted FCF 1,315). Dollar tax effect / NCI portion not published.

notes: is.op_income is COMPUTED (revenue - cost of sales - ESA - other operating lines): the income statement prints no operating income line; it equals the sum of segment operating income and the reconciling lines.
